part.label: Quad Standoff Mounting Plate
part.description: A base plate with four identical standoffs at the corners, each with a mounting hole through it, authored once as a group and repeated via a rectangular group pattern instead of hand-duplicating each standoff's position (and its hole feature's position) four times.

components.description: Authored once at the group's own local origin; the group pattern below repeats it at all four corners.

groups.description: One standoff, repeated at all four plate corners by the pattern below. mount_hole (a feature, not a group member) automatically repeats along with it, since it targets standoff.

features.description: M3 clearance hole through each standoff (one feature, authored once; it automatically repeats at all four corners along with its patterned target).
